question: Strategy tournament (players I/II/III, baselines, manifesto optimisers)
oracle_note: ORACLE = oracle_manifesto + balance.policy_planner on the true state (canonical streams). It is a HEURISTIC, not an optimum: the manifesto ignores the campaign and the planner is greedy; X13's search is the upper bound.

P_ordering_II_I_III.family: E and wins, II−I, I−III, II−III; Wilcoxon / exact McNemar, Holm per metric

M_manifesto_optimisers.family: PG (bayes) vs ADMM vs blend, game E and static share on the anticipated true electorate; Holm per metric

B_vs_baselines.family: each player − uniform / top3 (E Wilcoxon), Holm

x13_bound.note: bound = X13 open-loop search with the ORACLE manifesto, mean E over 20 fresh streams; players and ORACLE here are single canonical-stream games

deviations: Device cuda:0 instead of the plan default cuda:2 (cuda:2 is used by the Phase 2 agent).
